text:
[Council File 25-0843]
Report from the Department of City Planning relative to extending the provisions of Ordinance No. 188753 imposing a temporary citywide prohibition on the issuance of any demolition, building, grading, and any other applicable permit related to the approval of a Recreational Vehicle (RV) Park as a Public Benefit Project pursuant to Los Angeles Municipal Code Section 14.00(A)(7); for a second and last extension period of one year, inasmuch as the appropriate City agencies and officials are exercising due diligence and actively working towards the adoption of the appropriate permanent land use regulatory controls.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Extend temporary citywide prohibition on Recreational Vehicle Park permits for a second year.

details.action: Extend temporary prohibition on RV Park permits

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee approved item(s) (Sep 22, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 6, 2026)
